title: Task author — goal tasks for one member in one world

tasks.description: Ordered easy to hard; the most important one second.

scenario.description: Two or three sentences, second person, as the member would hear it: a reason and a goal, never steps, places or the app's own words.

answer.description: The fact from the fact sheet that proves success, as the member would report it, with an acceptable tolerance.

answerRegion.description: The fact sheet's id for that fact, exactly as listed.

outcome.description: Which desired outcome from the job map this task tests.
